quiz.title: IT Fundamentals Quiz
quiz.description: A 10-question review covering Java OOP, databases, data structures, operating systems and networking.

questions.question: Which Java keyword is used to create an object from a class?
questions.explanation: The 'new' keyword allocates memory and calls the constructor to create an object.

questions.question: What does the 'extends' keyword do in Java?
options: Allows a class to inherit from another class
questions.explanation: 'extends' establishes an inheritance relationship so the subclass inherits fields and methods from the parent.

questions.question: Which Swing method makes a JFrame visible on screen?
questions.explanation: setVisible(true) is the standard modern way to display a Swing window.

questions.question: Which SQL statement retrieves data from a table?
questions.explanation: SELECT is the SQL statement used to query and retrieve rows from a table.

questions.question: In an ERD, what does a primary key do?
options: Uniquely identifies each record in a table
Stores the largest value in a column
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each row and cannot contain NULL or duplicate values.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm repeatedly swaps adjacent elements that are out of order?
questions.explanation: Bubble Sort compares adjacent pairs and swaps them until the array is sorted.

questions.question: What is the average time complexity of Binary Search on a sorted array?
questions.explanation: Binary Search halves the search space each step, giving O(log n) average time.

questions.question: In First-Fit memory allocation, where is a process placed?
options: In the smallest block that fits
In the first block big enough for it
Always at the end of memory
questions.explanation: First-Fit scans from the start and uses the first block that is large enough.

questions.question: Which memory allocation method leaves the smallest leftover fragment?
questions.explanation: Best-Fit chooses the tightest fitting block, which minimises leftover space but can create many tiny fragments.

questions.question: How many usable host addresses are in a /24 subnet?
questions.explanation: A /24 has 256 total addresses. Subtracting the network and broadcast addresses leaves 254 usable hosts.

questions.question: What is the subnet mask for a /26 network?
questions.explanation: /26 means 26 network bits set, which gives 255.255.255.192.

questions.question: Which JavaScript method converts a JSON string into an object?
questions.explanation: JSON.parse() converts a JSON-formatted string into a JavaScript object.
